blocks.text: For the first time, Bela Padilla and tech entrepreneur Martin Tan have confirmed that they have been dating each other for eight months. The couple made the revelation in content creator Johnny K’s reel series “Meet Cute with Johnny K,” after they were spotted at a Sunday market in Makati City. When asked how they met, Tan said they were introduced through a common friend before he revealed that they have been together for eight months.
